data.plain_english: Hong Kong shares edged lower, mostly because borrowing costs in the US keep climbing and make investors more nervous everywhere. The council expects banks and property companies to struggle most where interest rates are high, especially in the US and Hong Kong. Technology is the biggest disagreement: Hong Kong tech has fallen recently, but a change to a major tech index could bring new buyers. Some members also think China's property shares may be rising on hope rather than solid evidence. This is research to help you think, not advice to buy or sell anything.

risk.method: council view 35% (negative views only), volatility 25% (8-25%), 1-month drawdown 20% (0 to -6%), disagreement 10%, unverified claims 10%; portfolio adds up to 10 points for market concentration
